phases.name: Foundation - Types and Core Hook
phases.description: Create TypeScript types and the core keyboard shortcuts hook with event handling

subtasks.title: Create TypeScript types for keyboard shortcuts
subtasks.description: Define interfaces for shortcut definitions, handlers, and the shortcut registry system in src/types/shortcuts.ts
acceptance_criteria: ShortcutDefinition interface with key, code, modifiers, description, handler
ShortcutCategory type for grouping shortcuts
ModifierKeys interface for ctrl, shift, alt, meta
ShortcutHandler type definition
subtasks.notes: Created src/types/shortcuts.ts with all required interfaces: ShortcutDefinition (with key, code, modifiers, description, handler, category), ShortcutCategory type, ModifierKeys interface, ShortcutHandler type, and supporting types (ShortcutRegistry, ShortcutGroup, ShortcutDisplayInfo, UseKeyboardShortcutsOptions, KeyboardShortcutsState). subtasks.title: Create core useKeyboardShortcuts hook
subtasks.description: Implement the main hook with event listener setup, focus detection, and modifier key handling
acceptance_criteria: Hook attaches global keydown listener to window
Properly cleans up event listener on unmount
Detects if user is typing in input/textarea/contentEditable
Handles modifier keys (Ctrl/Cmd, Shift, Alt)
Uses event.code for reliable key detection
Calls event.preventDefault() for captured shortcuts
subtasks.notes: Created src/hooks/useKeyboardShortcuts.ts with: global keydown event listener on window, proper cleanup on unmount, focus detection for input/textarea/contentEditable (isTypingInInput function), modifier key handling (modifiersMatch function), event.code for reliable key detection, event.preventDefault() for captured shortcuts, shortcut registry system with register/unregister/findMatch, modal/dialog detection, formatShortcutKeys helper for display. Committed as 36116bf.

subtasks.title: Add platform detection for Ctrl vs Cmd
subtasks.description: Add utility to detect Mac vs Windows for proper modifier key handling
acceptance_criteria: Detects Mac platform using navigator.platform or navigator.userAgent
Normalizes modifier key to 'meta' on Mac, 'ctrl' on Windows
Helper function to check if primary modifier is pressed
subtasks.notes:
Added platform detection utilities to useKeyboardShortcuts.ts:
- isMac(): Detects Mac using navigator.platform with fallback to userAgent, with SSR support and caching
- resetPlatformCache(): For testing purposes
- getPrimaryModifierKey(): Returns 'meta' on Mac, 'ctrl' on Windows/Linux
- isPrimaryModifierPressed(): Checks appropriate modifier key in keyboard events
- getPrimaryModifierLabel(): Returns '⌘' on Mac, 'Ctrl' on Windows
- withPrimaryModifier(): Creates ModifierKeys with platform-specific primary modifier
- withCrossplatformModifier(): Creates ModifierKeys with both ctrl and meta for cross-platform shortcuts
- Updated formatShortcutKeys() to display platform-appropriate symbols (⌘/⌥/⇧ on Mac, Ctrl/Alt/Shift on Windows)
Committed as 63754eb.

phases.name: Camera Preset Shortcuts

setPresetView accepts 'top' | 'sideline' | 'end-to-end' | 'broadcast'

phases.name: Tool Selection Shortcuts

subtasks.title: Implement tool selection shortcuts

A key (KeyA) selects arrow tool

Committed as 840d202.

subtasks.title: Create undo/redo state management
subtasks.description: Add undo/redo capabilities to track player positions, annotations, and camera state
acceptance_criteria: History store tracks state snapshots (player positions, annotations)
Undo action reverts to previous snapshot
Redo action restores next snapshot after undo
History is limited to prevent memory issues (e.g., 50 states)
Clear history when playbook is loaded
subtasks.notes:
Created src/store/historyStore.ts with full undo/redo state management:
- StateSnapshot interface tracking player positions (PlayerSnapshot) and annotations (AnnotationSnapshot)
- undo() action reverts to previous snapshot, returns state to restore
- redo() action restores next snapshot after undo
- maxHistorySize = 50 to prevent memory issues
- clearHistory() for loading new playbooks
- pauseRecording/resumeRecording helpers for undo/redo operations
- Helper functions: createPlayerSnapshot(), createAnnotationSnapshot(), createStateSnapshot()
- canUndo()/canRedo() for UI state
- getHistorySize() for debugging
Committed as 230108c.

subtasks.title: Integrate history tracking with existing stores
subtasks.description: Add history snapshot triggers to player and annotation stores
acceptance_criteria: Player position changes create history snapshots
Annotation additions/removals create history snapshots
Undo/redo properly restores both player and annotation state
subtasks.notes:
Integrated history snapshot triggers into both playerStore and annotationStore:

playerStore changes:
- Import historyStore and annotationStore
- updatePlayerPosition() and updatePlayerRotation() now push snapshots before changes
- Added restoreFromSnapshot(snapshots) method for undo/redo

annotationStore changes:
- Import historyStore with lazy getter for playerStore (avoids circular dependency)
- addAnnotation(), removeAnnotation(), clearAnnotations() now push snapshots before changes
- Added restoreFromSnapshot(snapshots) method for undo/redo

Key implementation details:
- Snapshots are pushed BEFORE state changes (so undo restores the previous state)
- isPaused flag is checked to prevent recursive snapshots during undo/redo operations
- clearAnnotations only pushes a snapshot if there are annotations to clear

Committed as c8a5aa4.

subtasks.title: Implement save, undo, and redo shortcuts
subtasks.description: Add Ctrl+S for save, Ctrl+Z for undo, Ctrl+Shift+Z and Ctrl+Y for redo
acceptance_criteria: Ctrl+S (Cmd+S on Mac) triggers save dialog
Ctrl+Z (Cmd+Z on Mac) triggers undo
Ctrl+Shift+Z (Cmd+Shift+Z on Mac) triggers redo
Ctrl+Y (Cmd+Y on Mac) also triggers redo
Browser default save dialog is prevented with event.preventDefault()
subtasks.notes:
Implemented edit operation keyboard shortcuts in useKeyboardShortcuts.ts:

- Ctrl+S (Cmd+S on Mac): Save playbook - requires onSave handler to be provided
- Ctrl+Z (Cmd+Z on Mac): Undo - uses performUndo() to restore previous state from historyStore
- Ctrl+Shift+Z (Cmd+Shift+Z on Mac): Redo - uses performRedo() to restore next state
- Ctrl+Y (Cmd+Y on Mac): Alternative redo shortcut

Key exports added:
- performUndo(): Direct undo operation, pauses history recording during execution
- performRedo(): Direct redo operation, pauses history recording during execution
- EditOperationShortcutHandlers interface: Options for save/undo/redo handlers
- registerEditOperationShortcuts(): Register shortcuts with optional handlers
- unregisterEditOperationShortcuts(): Cleanup function
- useEditOperationShortcuts(): React hook for component integration

Uses lazy store getters to avoid circular dependencies. Uses withPrimaryModifier() for platform-specific modifier keys (Cmd on Mac, Ctrl on Windows/Linux).

Committed as 96bfc8c.

subtasks.title: Create animation store
subtasks.description: Create store for managing animation playback state
acceptance_criteria: Animation store tracks isPlaying state
play(), pause(), togglePlayback() actions
Animation speed control (optional enhancement)
Store integrates with existing player/camera systems
subtasks.notes:
Created src/store/animationStore.ts with complete Zustand-based animation state management:

- **isPlaying state**: Tracks whether animation is currently playing
- **playbackState**: Enum (stopped/playing/paused) for detailed state
- **play(), pause(), togglePlayback() actions**: Core playback controls
- **Animation speed control**: setSpeed(), cycleSpeed() with presets (0.25x, 0.5x, 1x, 1.5x, 2x)
- **Progress tracking**: setProgress(), stepForward(), stepBackward(), jumpToStart(), jumpToEnd()
- **Loop control**: setLoop(), toggleLoop()
- **Configuration**: setDuration(), setHasAnimation()
- **Helper utilities**: getPlaybackStatusLabel(), getElapsedTime(), formatAnimationTime()

Store follows existing Zustand patterns from cameraStore and historyStore. Ready for integration with player/camera systems.

Committed as 700a6f9.

subtasks.title: Implement spacebar play/pause shortcut
subtasks.description: Add spacebar shortcut to toggle animation playback
acceptance_criteria: Spacebar (Space) toggles animation play/pause
Shortcut is disabled when typing in input fields
Browser scroll behavior is prevented
subtasks.notes:

- Added import for useAnimationStore
- Created registerAnimationControlShortcuts() function that registers spacebar (Space key) shortcut
- Created unregisterAnimationControlShortcuts() cleanup function
- Created useAnimationControlShortcuts() React hook that integrates with animationStore.togglePlayback()
- Shortcut uses code: 'Space', key: 'Space', no modifiers, category: 'animation'

subtasks.title: Make help overlay accessible
subtasks.description: Add keyboard navigation and ARIA attributes for accessibility
acceptance_criteria: Proper ARIA role and labels
Focus trapped within overlay when open
Tab key navigates between focusable elements
Screen reader friendly
subtasks.notes:
Added comprehensive accessibility features to HelpOverlay component:

**Focus Trapping (useFocusTrap hook):**
- Traps Tab/Shift+Tab navigation within the dialog
- Cycles from last to first element and vice versa
- Handles edge case when focus is outside container

**Focus Management (useFocusManagement hook):**
- Stores previously focused element before dialog opens
- Auto-focuses close button when dialog opens
- Restores focus to trigger element when dialog closes

**ARIA Attributes:**
- aria-haspopup="dialog" on trigger button
- role="dialog" moved to actual dialog element (not backdrop)
- aria-modal="true" for modal behavior
- aria-labelledby points to dialog title
- aria-describedby with screen-reader-only description
- tabIndex={-1} for programmatic focus

**Visual Accessibility:**
- Added visible focus ring (focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500) on close button
- Better hover/focus states for keyboard users

Committed as 215d4ba.

phases.name: Integration and State Management
phases.description: Integrate keyboard shortcuts hook into app and manage shortcut state

subtasks.title: Create keyboard shortcuts context
subtasks.description: Create store to manage shortcut state (enabled/disabled) and help overlay visibility
acceptance_criteria: Store tracks if shortcuts are enabled
Store tracks if help overlay is open
Actions to enable/disable shortcuts globally
Shortcuts auto-disabled when modal dialogs are open
subtasks.notes:
Created src/store/keyboardStore.ts with complete Zustand-based keyboard shortcut state management:

**State tracked:**
- shortcutsEnabled: Global enabled/disabled state
- helpOverlayOpen: Help overlay visibility
- disabledReason: Reason shortcuts are disabled (modal_open, user_disabled, input_focused, null)
- openModalCount: Count of open modals for nested modal support

**Actions:**
- enableShortcuts(), disableShortcuts(reason?), toggleShortcuts(): Global shortcut control
- openHelpOverlay(), closeHelpOverlay(), toggleHelpOverlay(), setHelpOverlayOpen(): Help overlay control
- registerModalOpen(), registerModalClose(): Modal tracking for auto-disable
- areShortcutsActive(): Helper to check if shortcuts should be processed
- reset(): Reset to default state

**Selectors exported:**
- selectShortcutsEnabled, selectHelpOverlayOpen, selectDisabledReason, selectAreShortcutsActive

Follows existing Zustand patterns from cameraStore and animationStore. Committed as e3dff53.

subtasks.title: Integrate keyboard shortcuts into App
subtasks.description: Add useKeyboardShortcuts hook to MainLayout
acceptance_criteria: Hook is called at root level
All shortcuts work from any part of the application
No duplicate event listeners
subtasks.notes:
Added useKeyboardShortcuts hook integration to MainLayout:

- Created KeyboardShortcutsHandler component that handles all keyboard shortcuts at the root level
- Imports and calls all shortcut registration hooks:
  - useCameraPresetShortcuts (keys 1-4 for camera views)
  - useToolSelectionShortcuts (S, L, A, C, R, T for annotation tools)
  - useEditOperationShortcuts (Ctrl+Z undo, Ctrl+Shift+Z/Ctrl+Y redo)
  - useAnimationControlShortcuts (spacebar for play/pause)
- Uses getGlobalShortcutRegistry() to share registry across all hooks
- Connects to keyboardStore.shortcutsEnabled for global enable/disable
- Calls useKeyboardShortcuts with the global registry to process keyboard events
- Placed outside Canvas in DOM layer UI section

HelpOverlay handles its own shortcuts (? to open, Esc to close) separately.
Note: Ctrl+S save handler will be wired up in subtask 7.3 via keyboardStore integration.

Committed as 490fb10.

subtasks.title: Handle dialog/modal interaction
subtasks.description: Disable shortcuts when save dialog or other modals are open
acceptance_criteria: Shortcuts disabled when save playbook dialog is open
Shortcuts disabled when help overlay is open (except Esc)
Shortcuts re-enabled when dialogs are closed
subtasks.notes:
Implemented modal/dialog detection and keyboard shortcut disabling:

**Toolbar.tsx changes:**
- Added keyboard store integration (registerModalOpen/registerModalClose)
- Save dialog now registers with keyboard store when opened/closed
- Added role="dialog", aria-modal="true", aria-labelledby for accessibility and modal detection
- Added Escape key handler to close save dialog
- Added click-outside-to-close functionality with backdrop overlay
- Added focus management (auto-focus name input when dialog opens)
- Improved accessibility with proper labels (htmlFor) and focus rings

**HelpOverlay.tsx changes:**
- Added keyboard store integration
- Registers with keyboard store when opened/closed
- Syncs helpOverlayOpen state for tracking

**MainLayout.tsx changes:**
- Changed from using `shortcutsEnabled` to `areShortcutsActive()`
- areShortcutsActive() checks: shortcutsEnabled && openModalCount === 0 && !helpOverlayOpen
- Shortcuts now automatically disabled when any modal is open

Committed as 1dcc868.
